title: Abanoonya Amazima Abasula
intro: Teebereza ekiseera enzikiriza we yasoomoozebwa, era ekibinja ky’emyoyo ne balonda okukkiriza okutakyukakyuka okusinga okubudaabudibwa okw’ensi. Olw’okuba baali boolekedde okusalawo okuzibu ennyo, baanoonya obubudamu, ne batandika olugendo olwalibatuusa ku tulo otw’ekitalo. Emboozi yaabwe bujulizi ku bukuumi bwa Katonda n’amaanyi g’okukkiriza okulwanyisa okunyigirizibwa. Osobola okutegeera abantu bano ab’ekitalo?
clues: Twali kibiina kitono, nga tugattibwa wamu olw’okukkiriza okw’amaanyi mu Mutonzi Omu.
Twabeera mu kiseera ng’omufuzi ow’amaanyi ayagala okusinza omulala atali Allah.
Okusobola okukuuma okukkiriza kwaffe, twasalawo okuleka amaka gaffe ne tudduka okunyigirizibwa.
Munnaffe omwesigwa, ekitonde ky’ensi, yatuwerekerako mu lugendo lwaffe.
Twasanga ekifo ekitukuvu mu kifo ekyesudde, Allah gye yatuleetera okuyingira otulo otungi, okumala ebbanga eddene.
Bwe twazuukuka, twakkiriza nti olunaku lumu lwokka oba ekitundu ky’olunaku lwali luyiseewo, naye ebyasa bingi byali biyiseewo ddala.

trial.answer: Okunoonya obuddukiro okuva eri omufuzi omutyobooli

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
